notes.es: Snapshot documental. La ejecución queda deshabilitada hasta verificar catálogo, cuenta, costo y entitlement mediante preflight.
notes.en: Documentation snapshot. Execution remains disabled until catalog, account, cost, and entitlement are verified by preflight. Concurrency is account-specific; leave null until Cloud dashboard confirms.

notes.es: Techo de generación única: 30 s (FAQ Higgsfield). preferredResolution 480p (el catálogo MCP por defecto es 720p; Light Delay no debe derivar). Catálogo MCP confirmado 2026-09-14; executable true para tramos con videoPromptFreeze approved. Cada envío pagado sigue exigiendo get_cost + confirmación humana. Concurrencia por cuenta/plan; preflight debe anotar el techo vivo.
notes.en: Single-pass ceiling: 30 s (Higgsfield FAQ). preferredResolution 480p (MCP catalog default is 720p; Light Delay must pass 480p explicitly). MCP catalog confirmed 2026-09-14; executable true for stretches with videoPromptFreeze approved. Each paid submit still requires get_cost plus human confirmation. Concurrent slots are account/plan-specific and change (API 400 when hit; Concurrency Boost can raise). Record live concurrency in preflight; maxConcurrentRequests stays null until verified.

notes.es: Snapshot provisional para hojas storyboard combinadas. maxImages = referencias de entrada; maxOutputsPerRequest = salidas por petición.
notes.en: Provisional snapshot for combined storyboard sheets. maxImages = input reference count; maxOutputsPerRequest = outputs per request. Execution remains disabled until account/API verification.

notes.es: Segmentos hasta 30 s, alineados con Seedance 2.5. concurrency null hasta preflight de cuenta. Smoke siempre maxJobs: 1.
notes.en: Segments up to 30 s, aligned with Seedance 2.5 maxDurationMs. Campaign concurrency is the project ceiling once verified (null until then). Smoke executionPolicy always forces maxJobs: 1 regardless of platform parallel capacity; later batching must respect min(campaign.concurrency, account limit).
